summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Blueprint AI (construction blueprint reader). All 13 backend pytest tests pass covering upload validation (unsupported ext/empty file rejection with 400), project CRUD, soft delete, file retrieval, background Gemini 3.1 Pro analysis (image reached status=ready within ~90s with full rooms/walls/openings/overall/summary/warnings schema), reanalyze, message history, and SSE chat streaming (deltas + done event + persistence). Frontend playwright flow validated: workspace load, sidebar project selection, blueprint image viewer with zoom-in/out/reset, analysis-summary with title+summary, dimension-table tabs (rooms=4, walls=7, openings=2), search filter (kitchen -> 1 row), CSV export download, chat textarea enabled when ready, new-project navigation back to upload-panel.
critical_code_review_comments: ai.py uses os.remove(path) in a finally block without a guard; a failure during _write_temp before file creation would raise FileNotFoundError (minor).
server.py load_file reads full file into memory for every chat request (OK for 20MB cap, but no caching between consecutive chats on same project).
No pagination on GET /api/projects (hard-capped at 500) or /messages (1000) - fine for single-user MVP.
SSE endpoint does not emit a terminal event on exception before 'done' is yielded; frontend treats 'done' as end-of-stream which is correctly implemented.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject for credentialed requests - acceptable here since no auth cookies are used.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed projects and self-cleanup via DELETE. Pre-existing 'Sample Ground Floor' project (ready) was used for frontend viewer/table/chat verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_blueprint_api.py. Analysis is real-LLM and ~40-90s; use timeout>=180s. Sample project id persists; chat messages accumulate on it so suggested-prompt chips may not appear if msgs already exist. PDF upload path was not exercised end-to-end (only image); backend accepts application/pdf via MIME map and ext whitelist, same code path.
